newsitem.title: USA: Bonneville next-day power price offers unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Bonneville next-day power price offers unchanged.

text.p: Bonneville Power Administration left its offers for next-day pre-scheduled power unchanged after the three-day weekend, the federal agency said Tuesday.
For Wednesday, BPA continued to offer block power during heavy load hours at $18.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) in the Northwest and $19.50 at the California-Oregon (COB) and Nevada-Oregon (NOB) borders.
Off-peak firm sales for all deliveries were still offered at $15.00 per MWh.
Non-firm power between 0700 and 2200 PDT was offered at $18.50 (Northwest) and $20.00 (COB/NOB).
BPA also continued to offer non-firm power during light load and shoulder hours for all delivery points at $15.00-16.00 for Wednesday pre-schedulings.
